description: Takes authors off an alert's muted list and keeps the rest of the filter. Each entry can be the stored value or a link to the person's profile or posts. Authors not on the list are skipped.

inputSchema.description: The authors to add to the alert's muted list, or take off it.

authors.description: A profile link (x.com/name, linkedin.com/in/name, reddit.com/user/name), post link, handle (@name, u/name), Bluesky DID or display name. Links are stored as the author's profile. A bare name or handle covers every platform.

name: unmute_authors
title: Unmute authors
